lines.japanese: ──よし、このまま起こさずに休んでていただこう。
lines.english: —All right. I would leave her to rest without waking her.

lines.japanese: 俺ごとき新人ヘルパーが、先輩の安眠を妨げるなどもってのほかです。まあ、どうせですから、もうちょっと見ていたいってのもありますし──
lines.english: A lowly rookie like me had no business disturbing a senior colleague's peaceful slumber. And, well, since I was here anyway, part of me wanted to keep looking a little longer—

lines.japanese: ──アッ！　いや！　違うんですよ！　決していやらしい気持ちで言ってるわけじゃなくてですね！
lines.english: —AH! No! That's not what I mean! I assure you, there was nothing indecent in it!

lines.japanese: ええとほら、だって日和子さん、一見ただ安らかにお昼寝してるだけのようにも見えますけど──
lines.english: I mean, look, at first glance Hiyoko just seems to be taking a nice, peaceful nap, but—

lines.japanese: ──でもですよ？　あの日和子さんが、こんなところで無防備に横たわっているなんて、きっと只事じゃありませんよ？　もしかしたら持病とか急病とかそんなんで意識を失ってるのかもしれないじゃないですか。
lines.english: —but consider this: Hiyoko, of all people, lying defenseless in a place like this? Something had to be wrong. She might have lost consciousness from a chronic condition, or some sudden illness.

lines.japanese: だから落ちつけ、パンツなんて気にしてる場合じゃない、落ちついてよーく観察……
lines.english: So calm down. This was no time to think about panties. Calmly, carefully observe…

lines.japanese: ……へえー、日和子さん、今日はピンクかあ。いっつもベージュってわけじゃないんだなあ。
lines.english: …Oh. Pink today. So Hiyoko didn't always wear beige.

lines.japanese: いやいや、それは落ちつき過ぎだろ。よくない、よくない。
lines.english: No, no, that was much too calm. Not good. Not good at all.

lines.japanese: よくないけど、しかしアレ綺麗な脚だなあ。ねーホント、無駄な肉ついてないし、肌がきめ細かいし、うわあ触りてぇー。
lines.english: Not good—but God, those were beautiful legs. Really, look at them: not a scrap of excess flesh, skin so fine and smooth… God, I wanted to touch them.

lines.japanese: いや違う違う違う、性的な意味じゃなくて、ほんとあの、日和子さんのね、あの、日和子さんの健康を気遣って言ってるだけでね、ええ。
lines.english: No, no, no. I didn't mean sexually. I was merely expressing concern for Hiyoko's… for Hiyoko's health. Yes.

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひよこさぁーん……？」
lines.english: “H-Hiyokooo…?”

lines.japanese: もにょもにょして来ないうちに、とりあえず呼んでみました。声が及び腰になってるのはご愛敬です。
lines.english: Before I could start getting all weird about it, I tried calling her name. Please excuse how timid my voice sounded.

lines.japanese: うーん、起きませんね。
lines.english: Hmm. She wasn't waking up.

lines.japanese: でもすーすー言ってますね。あらまあ、すやすやと、なんて安らかな寝顔。
lines.english: But she was breathing softly. Well, now. Sleeping like a baby, with such a peaceful look on her face.

lines.japanese: ていうか、や、改めて言うのもなんですけど、ホント綺麗なお顔してますよねこのお嬢さん。
lines.english: I mean—okay, I know this hardly needs saying, but this girl really does have a beautiful face.

lines.japanese: 「目を閉じてる状態でも美人だったら、それは本物だよ」なんていう、偉そうな審美眼を持つカケルくんの言葉を思いだしました。
lines.english: I remembered Kakeru holding forth like some great authority on beauty: 'If a girl's still beautiful with her eyes closed, that's how you know she's the real thing.'

lines.japanese: ていうかまあ、顔の造作うんぬん以前に、中身の方が可愛いんですけどねこの子の場合。
lines.english: I mean, with her, it’s not even about her looks. Who she is on the inside is even cuter.

lines.japanese: あれ？　やっぱり俺、惚れてるっぽい？
lines.english: Wait. Did that mean I really was in love with her?

lines.japanese: いや、だからだから！　いまはそんな、しみじみ見とれてる場合じゃないんだって。万が一こんなとこに誰かが入ってきたら……
lines.english: No, no! This was no time to stand here gazing dreamily at her. What if somebody walked in…?

lines.japanese: 入ってきたら……
lines.english: If somebody walked in...

lines.japanese: いや、まあ……俺、なんもしてないし、べつに問題ないんだけど。
lines.english: Well… I wasn't doing anything, so technically there was no problem.

lines.japanese: ないんだけど、しかし、日和子さんのおみ足（とか色々）を俺以外の誰か、とくにマスターや男子スタッフに見せるってーのは、どうにも我慢がなりません。さっさと起きていただきたいものです。
lines.english: No problem, perhaps. But the thought of anyone besides me—especially the Master or one of the male staff—seeing Hiyoko's shapely legs (and assorted other attractions) was simply intolerable. I wished she would hurry up and wake.
